chapters.title: Chapter 5330: A Flicker of Quintessence! IV
paragraphs: Even amid the broader fighting, even with the Swords and the Relictus and the dozens of other Gilded Ones locked in their own engagements, the destruction of a Fourth Scale Ragnar in a single exchange registered. Heads turned.
Luxanna, locked in her Intent-contest with Sir William, watched coldly, her malevolent eyes narrowing.
Noah did not pause!
The second and third Ragnars came at him together, their Quiescent Verdicts merging into a combined stilling pressure, and Noah amplified THE Prime Cause of Apocalypse through his Aura.

The sky above the two Ragnars filled with meteors. Not ordinary meteors, but condensed masses of THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian shaped by the Apocalypse Cause’s truth that endings were transformative, decillions of them forming in an omnidirectional spread and crashing down toward the two Ragnars from every angle at once.
The Quiescent Verdict tried to still them, to convince the meteors that falling was too much effort, but the meteors carried Noah’s record, and Noah’s record did not still!

They crashed into the two Ragnars and through them and past them, the impacts detonating across the gray Fourth Scale frames, and where the meteors landed, the Apocalypse Cause expressed its truth, the Ragnars’ endings becoming the violent beginnings of their conversion. Their bodies broke apart under the bombardment, and Noah’s Aura devoured the remnants.
Three.
The fourth and fifth he addressed with THE Prime Cause of Paradox!

He manifested a box around them, formed of his Aura and backed by the Paradox Cause, and the box existed and did not exist simultaneously, the two Ragnars inside it both alive and not, both present and absent.

The Quiescent Verdict could not impose stillness on a state that was already a contradiction, because stillness required a stable thing to still, and the contents of the box were not stable in any direction the Intent could grip. Then Noah snapped the box closed.

The contradiction resolved violently in the only direction Noah permitted it to resolve, and the two Ragnars inside were crushed by the collapse of a paradox that had held them suspended between states, their bodies compacting into a point and then dissolving as the Aura took them.
Five!
HUUM!

Seo-yeon watched all of it from beside him, her small hand in his, her eyes wide with inquisitive wonder rather than fear. She tracked each manifestation of his Aura with the fascinated attention of a child watching something genuinely interesting, occasionally tilting her head at a particularly novel expression, entirely unbothered by the titanic violence occurring around her!

The sixth, seventh, and eighth Ragnars came at him in a coordinated descent, their combined Quiescent Verdict reaching its strongest expression, three Fourth Scale Intents merged into a single overwhelming stillness.
Noah manifested a Primordial Realm around them.

It bloomed from his Aura, a contained domain of flames, the obsidian gold and multicolored fire of THE Source Barbarian filling the space the three Ragnars occupied, and within the realm, decillions of fireballs formed and roared with the expression of everything Noah was.

The three Ragnars hung in a sea of his fire, and the combined Quiescent Verdict tried to still the flames, to convince them that burning was effortful and cessation was natural, but the flames were Noah’s record, and Noah’s record burned without exhaustion because it had been forged in cycles of apocalypses and had never once gone out!
HUUM!

The fireballs scorched the three Ragnars from every direction, the manifested Primordial Realm becoming a furnace that the Acedia Dredges could not still and could not escape, and their gray bodies blackened and broke under the bombardment until nothing coherent remained, and the Aura devoured the ash.
Eight.

The ninth and final Ragnar reached him alone, its Quiescent Verdict blazing with whatever the engineering had loaded into a single unit, and Noah simply reached out with one hand wreathed in THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian and the Prime Cause of Tyranny.
The Tyranny froze it. One instant, the foundational truth of hierarchy pressing against the soulless Ragnar’s capacity for autonomous movement, and in that instant Noah closed his hand.

THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian, carrying the full weight of his existence and the thousand-fold amplified Pure Primordial Essence, crushed the Fourth Scale Ragnar’s foundations the way a man crushed something that had stopped being able to resist, and the gray body imploded into Noah’s grip and dissolved into the obsidian gold light, devoured like all the others!
BOOM!
Nine.
Nine seconds had passed!

Noah floated in the sky above Chernobyl, unblemished, holding a little girl’s hand, THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian radiating off his frame with a density that pressed down on the entire battlefield. The blue and obsidian radiances of the Blessing still wove through the obsidian gold, the Pure Primordial Essence still pouring into him, and the combined expression of all of it made the space around him feel heavy.
Oh, so heavy!
The battlefield had gone silent.

Every Gilded One that could see him had stopped, the broader fighting faltering as the implication of what had just occurred reached them. Nine Fourth Scale Ragnars, even soulless Acedia Dredge configurations, were not a small force. They were a force that should have required the combined attention of multiple Source Lifeforms to address. A being had just removed all nine in nine seconds while holding a child’s hand and never once appearing to exert genuine effort!

The Swords of Existence had paused in their own battles. Even Sir William, still locked in his Intent-contest with Luxanna, had shifted a portion of his attention toward Noah, and his composed features carried something that had not been there before, the recalibration of a being who had suspected Noah was exceptional and was now revising the assessment upward past where he had set it!
Luxanna stared, her malevolent eyes wide, her covetous hunger sharpened into something that bordered on need.
Noah looked across the assembled Gilded Ones.

The Aura of THE Source Barbarian pressed down from him, oppressive and grand, and his expression carried the calm tyranny of a being who had just remembered something he enjoyed and had decided to indulge it.

"You know," he said, and his voice carried across the silent battlefield with the weight of everything radiating off him,"I haven’t gone all out in quite some time. I keep finding reasons to hold back. Conserve. Be efficient. Handle things with the minimum required."
He looked at the dragon, at the Fourth Scale Gilded Ones behind her, at the dozens of others scattered across the reborn sky of Chernobyl.
"But Gilded Ones continue pissing me off again and again..."
The Aura blazed.
"Today seems right," he said. "Today seems right to go all out."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5331: Resonance I
paragraphs: Noah gazed across the Gilded Ones with boundless Tyranny, and his heart began to beat!
DUM!
DUM!
DUM!

It was not a ridiculous metaphor for nerves. He felt it in his chest, a single heavy beat that did not belong entirely to his body, and the sound of it boomed outward across Chernobyl, a drum struck once and then again, the rhythm spreading across the reborn Observable Existence with a resonance that should not have been possible.

His gaze settled particularly on Luxanna, and as the drum of his heart sounded, he felt something he had not felt before. The beat of his heart resonated with Chernobyl itself, the Observable Existence answering the rhythm as though his heart and its foundations were the same instrument played by the same hand.

Such a thing should not have been a thought in any being’s mind. An existence becoming one with an Observable Existence was not a concept that the frameworks of cultivation accounted for, because beings lived within Observable Existences, they did not...merge with them.
But Noah was not conventional. His Scales were his own. His path had never matched anyone else’s, and at this moment he looked at Chernobyl and asked himself a simple question!
Had he not resuscitated it?

Did its makeup not now hold his Prime Causes, installed by his own hands where the failing common Causes had been? Was it not backed by his Infinite Cause, the same Cause that backed THE Infiniverse, the Cause that had brought this domain back from death? He could express his power through THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian. That was his own strength, carried in his own existence. But if his Prime Causes lived inside Chernobyl’s structure, expressing themselves on behalf of an entire Observable Existence, then what stopped him from pulling on that power too?
What stopped him from exerting the full immensity of Chernobyl as though every being fighting here was fighting within his domain?
Because, truly, they were!
DUM! DUM! DUM!
The drums boomed louder!

The glorious sound of Quintessence spread across Chernobyl, and beings throughout the battlefield faltered as the entire Observable Existence seemed to resonate with the beat, the reborn domain pulsing in time with the heart of the being who had rebuilt it!

|Phenomenon identified: Resonance with Observable Existence. You have achieved a unified state with THE Observable Existence of Chernobyl, which holds your Prime Causes and the backing of your Infinite Cause within its structural foundation. This phenomenon has no precedent in standard frameworks. Beings inhabit Observable Existences. They do not become one with them. Your resuscitation of Chernobyl, and your installation of your own Prime Cause architecture into its First Cause, has produced a connection that allows your existence to command the full immensity of the domain.|
|Capability designation: THE Domain of the Genesis Monarch.|

|While resonant with an Observable Existence backed by your Prime Causes and Infinite Cause, you command that Observable Existence as an extension of your own existence. Any movement you make is backed by the full power and immensity of the domain. The Observable Existence itself fights on your behalf. Its substrate, its Prime Causes, its foundational authority, all of it answers to your intention.|
|Effects within THE Domain of the Genesis Monarch:|

|Containment: You may shut out or shut in any existence at the Fourth Scale, sealing enemies within the domain so they cannot flee or barring others from entering. Rare exceptions apply to beings carrying Akashic Civilizational Intents of the third rarity or higher, or unique factors not accounted for, who may resist or partially resist the containment.|

|Suppression: Enemy existences within the domain find their power diminished and their movements restricted, the Observable Existence itself turning against them, the substrate they stand upon refusing to support them as it supports you.|
|Empowerment: Your allies within the domain are elevated, the Observable Existence lending its immensity to those you favor, their power amplified by the domain’s backing.|

|Sovereignty of Action: Any expression of your power is compounded by the domain’s full immensity. A gesture from you is not a gesture from a single being. It is the action of an entire Observable Existence directed through your intention.|

|Resilience: While resonant, harming you requires harming the Observable Existence itself, making you extraordinarily difficult to kill within the domain’s bounds. Damage directed at you is distributed across the domain’s immensity and absorbed.|
|Note: This capability is available within any Observable Existence backed by your Prime Causes and Infinite Cause.Currently: THE Infiniverse and THE Observable Existence of Chernobyl.|
Noah’s mind buzzed with the knowledge of exactly what he could now do!
He understood it completely in the span of a single drum-beat. He was not a being standing in a battlefield anymore. Hewas the battlefield!
Chernobyl was his, foundation to surface, and everyone fighting within it was fighting inside the body of his domain, and he could move that body the way he moved his own hand.
So he moved his hand.
He raised it, slowly, like a conductor calling an orchestra to attention, and across the regions of Chernobyl, the effects began.

The very air and existence that the Gilded Ones floated within began to constrict. It pressed around them from all sides, the substrate they occupied turning against them, the immensity of the Prime Causes that made up Chernobyl, his Prime Causes, bearing down on every single Gilded One across the battlefield.

They felt the domain itself become hostile, the ground beneath their power refusing to hold them, the air and space becoming a weight, the Observable Existence they had invaded recognizing them as foreign and rejecting them.
Then Noah waved his arm!
HUUM!

An invisible force, stemming from the Observable Existence itself rather than from his body, smashed into the assembled Gilded Ones. The myriad Fourth Scale Gilded Ones and the few Devonian Paleozoic Third Scale Gilded Ones among them were struck simultaneously by a blow that came from everywhere at once, a blow that was Chernobyl itself striking them on Noah’s behalf.

Many of them had their Akashic Civilizational Intents bypassed entirely, because their Intents were records imposed on existence, and within THE Domain of the Genesis Monarch, the existence they tried to impose their records upon already belonged to someone else.

Their Intents had nothing to grip! The invisible force tore through them and they were heavily injured, Fourth Scale beings sent reeling by the wrath of a domain that had decided they were trespassers!

chapters.title: Chapter 5332: Resonance II
paragraphs: And then the surrounding existence opened itself.

It opened like jaws, invisible but unmistakable in effect, the light of THE Prime Cause of Harvest blooming across the regions of Chernobyl as the Observable Existence itself swallowed Noah’s enemies. Gilded Ones who had been injured by the invisible force found the domain closing around them, the substrate becoming a mouth, the Harvest Cause converting portions of what they were into fuel that flowed back through Chernobyl and into Noah, the Observable Existence feeding on the invaders on behalf of the being it now answered to!
WUU!
The invisible force completed its arc and smashed into Luxanna.
The silver dragon, third rarity, Titan Intent, was not bypassed the way the lesser Gilded Ones had been. Her Akashic Civilizational Intent was rare enough to resist.

But resisting was not the same as being unaffected. The blow pushed her back a full step in the air, her silver Acedia Intent raging around her to absorb the force, her cruel features tightening as she felt the full weight of an Observable Existence press against her and only barely held her ground.
Across the battlefield, Sir William and the three other Source Lifeforms and the twelve Relictus felt the opposite.

The domain lent them its immensity. Their existences blazed with sudden empowerment, the Observable Existence of Chernobyl elevating those Noah favored, and the Swords of Existence felt their Intents strengthen and their Armaments grow heavier with borrowed authority while the Relictus burned brighter with the domain’s backing!
Sir William, still positioned near Luxanna, registered the empowerment raging around his existence with a sharp recalculation.
Noah looked at Luxanna, cold and grand, the drums of his heart still booming across the domain that was now an extension of his existence.
"A Lifeform has been saying something lately," he said. "Manners maketh man."

He let the Aura blaze around him, let the immensity of Chernobyl press through every word."I don’t have any manners. So this is going to be brutal." His gaze fixed on the silver dragon. "Are you ready?"
Luxanna began to laugh.

It started low and built into something mad, her malevolent eyes alight, her cruel smile stretching wide despite the step she had been forced back, despite the domain pressing against her, despite the nine Ragnars gone in nine seconds and the invisible wrath of an Observable Existence that had turned against her.

"Challenge invites challenge, big guy!"she called, delighted and unhinged. "The more challenging you are, the more power you express, the more I will call upon more forces! I will run this entire place into the ground with Gilded Ones! I will summon every reserve, every Legion, every weapon, I will bury you and your little girl under so many of us that even your pretty domain cannot eat us all, I will-"
BOOM!
She did not finish.
Noah erupted.

THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian blazed to its full expression, and with it came the immensity of THE Domain of the Genesis Monarch, his own power and the power of an entire Observable Existence merging into a single strike, the drums of his heart booming one final thunderous beat as he moved against Luxanna with everything he was and everything Chernobyl was, the obsidian gold and the blue Blessing-light and the nine Prime Causes and the full weight of a domain that fought on his behalf, all of it driving toward the silver dragon and the rare Intent that was the only thing standing between his strike and her existence!
HUUUM!
He sought to get past her Intent.
He intended to find out, today, going all out, exactly what he could break!
BOOOM!
Noah’s strike landed on Luxanna, and the entire Observable Existence felt it!
The combined force of THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian and the immensity of Chernobyl behind it caught the silver dragon and smashed her backward,and backward here was not a few meters.

She was driven from one end of the Observable Existence toward the other,her enormous frame tearing across the reborn sky, her silver Acedia Intent raging around her to absorb what it could and absorbing only some of it!

The blow carried her across a distance that no conventional strike could have carried a Fourth Scale Gilded One like het, because it was not a conventional strike. It was a domain striking on behalf of its master!
From Noah’s Aura and the Prime Causes of Chernobyl, a massive chain erupted.
It shot after Luxanna as she tumbled across the domain, multicolored and obsidian gold, vast enough to dwarf the silver cloud she rode, and it tried to pierce into her. But her Intent was grand!

The third-rarity Titan Intent of artificial Acedia covered her existence in a silver record that even Noah’s chain could not simply punch through, but it did, and the chain’s tip barely managed to anchor itself into her scales, hooking into the silver plating rather than driving through it.
Barely was enough.
"Get over here!" Noah roared.
BOOM!

The chain hauled taut and Luxanna was pulled forward like a sack of potatoes, dragged back across the distance she had been smashed across, and she laughed the entire way, mad and delighted, her Intent erupting as she came!

All her knowledge, all her records, the full sum of the engineered existence that mimicked The Great Sloevin, unfurled around her like an endless silver sea, vast and dulling and pressing against everything it touched.
At that moment, Sir William and the three other Source Lifeforms appeared.
They arrived around Luxanna from four points, and each of them spoke the same word.
"Destruere."

The letter of THE Primordial Tongue gave their Intents a terrifying edge. Sir William’s Titan Intent of dignity, the sniper’s Nereid Intent, the hammer-bearer’s, the flail-wielder’s, all four sharpened by the Primordial Source letter into something that the silver sea of Luxanna’s record could not simply dull.

Four attacks released simultaneously, four Intents backed by Destruere, converging on the silver dragon from every direction. Chernobyl constricted around her as Noah’s aura penetrated deeper and cut!
The impact obscured everything in obsidian and silver light!
WAA!
When the dust settled, Luxanna’s Intent had finally been torn!

She breathed heavily, huge gashes opened across her body, silver blood leaking from wounds that her Acedia record had not been able to prevent, her Intent now wrapped heavily around her entire existence in a desperate effort to hold herself together.

The endless silver sea had been carved into, the artificial Titan Intent shown its limit when four Source Lifeforms wielding the Primordial Tongue committed to ending it at once alongside a man nobody understood!

The blow pushed her back a full step in the air, her silver Acedia Intent raging around her to absorb the force, her cruel features tightening as she felt the full weight of an Observable Existence press against her and only barely held her ground.
Across the battlefield, Sir William and the three other Source Lifeforms and the twelve Relictus felt the opposite.
The domain lent them its immensity.

Their existences blazed with sudden empowerment, the Observable Existence of Chernobyl elevating those Noah favored, and the Swords of Existence felt their Intents strengthen and their Armaments grow heavier with borrowed authority while the Relictus burned brighter with the domain’s backing!
Sir William, still positioned near Luxanna, registered the empowerment raging around his existence with a sharp recalculation.
Noah looked at Luxanna, cold and grand, the drums of his heart still booming across the domain that was now an extension of his existence.
"A Lifeform has been saying something lately," he said.
"Manners maketh man."
He let the Aura blaze around him, let the immensity of Chernobyl press through every word."I don’t have any manners.
So this is going to be brutal." His gaze fixed on the silver dragon.
"Are you ready?"
Luxanna began to laugh.

It started low and built into something mad, her malevolent eyes alight, her cruel smile stretching wide despite the step she had been forced back, despite the domain pressing against her, despite the nine Ragnars gone in nine seconds and the invisible wrath of an Observable Existence that had turned against her.
"Challenge invites challenge, big guy!"she called, delighted and unhinged.
"The more challenging you are, the more power you express, the more I will call upon more forces!
I will run this entire place into the ground with Gilded Ones!
I will summon every reserve, every Legion, every weapon, I will bury you and your little girl under so many of us that even your pretty domain cannot eat us all, I will-"
BOOM!
She did not finish.
Noah erupted.

THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian blazed to its full expression, and with it came the immensity of THE Domain of the Genesis Monarch, his own power and the power of an entire Observable Existence merging into a single strike, the drums of his heart booming one final thunderous beat as he moved against Luxanna with everything he was and everything Chernobyl was, the obsidian gold and the blue Blessing-light and the nine Prime Causes and the full weight of a domain that fought on his behalf, all of it driving toward the silver dragon and the rare Intent that was the only thing standing between his strike and her existence!
HUUUM!
He sought to get past her Intent.
He intended to find out, today, going all out, exactly what he could break!
BOOOM!
Noah’s strike landed on Luxanna, and the entire Observable Existence felt it!
The combined force of THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian and the immensity of Chernobyl behind it caught the silver dragon and smashed her backward,and backward here was not a few meters.

She was driven from one end of the Observable Existence toward the other,her enormous frame tearing across the reborn sky, her silver Acedia Intent raging around her to absorb what it could and absorbing only some of it!
The blow carried her across a distance that no conventional strike could have carried a Fourth Scale Gilded One like het, because it was not a conventional strike.
It was a domain striking on behalf of its master!
From Noah’s Aura and the Prime Causes of Chernobyl, a massive chain erupted.
It shot after Luxanna as she tumbled across the domain, multicolored and obsidian gold, vast enough to dwarf the silver cloud she rode, and it tried to pierce into her.
But her Intent was grand!

The third-rarity Titan Intent of artificial Acedia covered her existence in a silver record that even Noah’s chain could not simply punch through, but it did, and the chain’s tip barely managed to anchor itself into her scales, hooking into the silver plating rather than driving through it.
Barely was enough.
"Get over here!" Noah roared.
BOOM!

The chain hauled taut and Luxanna was pulled forward like a sack of potatoes, dragged back across the distance she had been smashed across, and she laughed the entire way, mad and delighted, her Intent erupting as she came!

All her knowledge, all her records, the full sum of the engineered existence that mimicked The Great Sloevin, unfurled around her like an endless silver sea, vast and dulling and pressing against everything it touched.
At that moment, Sir William and the three other Source Lifeforms appeared.
They arrived around Luxanna from four points, and each of them spoke the same word.
"Destruere."
The letter of THE Primordial Tongue gave their Intents a terrifying edge.

Sir William’s Titan Intent of dignity, the sniper’s Nereid Intent, the hammer-bearer’s, the flail-wielder’s, all four sharpened by the Primordial Source letter into something that the silver sea of Luxanna’s record could not simply dull.
Four attacks released simultaneously, four Intents backed by Destruere, converging on the silver dragon from every direction.
Chernobyl constricted around her as Noah’s aura penetrated deeper and cut!
The impact obscured everything in obsidian and silver light!
WAA!
When the dust settled, Luxanna’s Intent had finally been torn!

She breathed heavily, huge gashes opened across her body, silver blood leaking from wounds that her Acedia record had not been able to prevent, her Intent now wrapped heavily around her entire existence in a desperate effort to hold herself together.

The endless silver sea had been carved into, the artificial Titan Intent shown its limit when four Source Lifeforms wielding the Primordial Tongue committed to ending it at once alongside a man nobody understood!

chapters.title: Chapter 5333: Sword of Existence! I
paragraphs: Noah frowned at this time, looking at Sir William and the others.

He had not particularly wanted their help. He had been getting there. THE Domain of the Genesis Monarch and his Aura had been narrowing toward an answer of his own. But he set the irritation aside, because the result was the result, and there was a more pressing point to make.
He looked at Luxanna.
"Can you hear that?" he asked.
The silence.

Luxanna’s malevolent eyes flicked around the battlefield, and the laughter died in her throat, because there was nothing to hear. The dozens of Gilded Ones who had descended with her, the Fourth Scale entities and the Devonian Paleozoic Third Scale ones, were gone. All of them!

In the short span while she had been smashed across the domain and dragged back and torn open by the four Source Lifeforms, Noah had acted against every one of them through THE Domain of the Genesis Monarch, using his Aura and Chernobyl together to incapacitate them and feed them to the Observable Existence’s open jaws, devouring them one after another while she had been occupied with her own survival.
The battlefield held no Gilded Ones but her.
"Only you remain, Lu-xa-nna," Noah said coldly.
BOOM!

His words carried across the silent domain, and beside him, Seo-yeon smiled with shining eyes, watching with the bright absorbed attention of a child who had just been taught a grand lesson she intended to remember.
One had to fight like this!
Luxanna looked at the empty battlefield where her forces had been, and then she laughed.
It came back, the mad evil light returning to her eyes despite the gashes and the heavy breathing and the torn Intent wrapped around her like a bandage.

"Only I remain," she said, savoring it. "For now. For now, big guy. In a few seconds, dozens more just like me will arrive. And some far stronger than me. Because that is the rule, isn’t it? Challenge invites challenge. Power invites more power. You showed me how strong you are, and now I will show you exactly what that strength summons. They are already coming. Every reserve. Every Legion. You have made yourself far too interesting to ignore!"
Noah frowned at these words.
At that moment, words reached him that only he could hear, stemming from Sir William.

"If we remain here, this Observable Existence will be crushed under the weight of the forces coming. It has only just been resuscitated. Its foundations are new and its First Cause is freshly rebuilt, and it cannot survive becoming the battleground for what she is summoning. For now, you and Seo-yeon need to go where the Gilded Ones cannot follow. You need to go...to THE Source Lands."
BOOM!
THE Source Lands.

Where the Gilded Ones had just made their entry into THE Strand of Broken Scales. Where his other body walked among Marxist’s settlement under the name Ozymandias. Where the Gilded Ones were already present and already hunting!
Noah’s eyes shone brightly.
He looked at Sir William and nodded. The logic was sound, and the irony of fleeing toward the Gilded Ones to escape the Gilded Ones was unique.
In the next moment, Sir William unsheathed his sword, and an obsidian sea arose, wrapping around himself, Noah, Seo-yeon, the three other Source Lifeforms, and the surrounding Relictus.
Luxanna saw it and roared, shock and rage twisting her cruel features.
"You cowards!" she howled. "Wait just two seconds! Just two seconds so we can corner you and this whole place! Wait just a fucking—"
BOOM!
The obsidian sea churned and exploded.

Obsidian streaks shot out across Chernobyl in multiple directions at once, racing toward THE Undefined Gaps, toward the boundary of the Observable Existence and the unclassified spaces beyond it, scattering so that no single pursuit could catch all of them. Luxanna roared and split her torn Intent to chase several of the streaks while choosing one sliver to pursue with her own body, the silver dragon hurling herself after a fleeing obsidian streak with everything her wounded existence had left.
"Wait! A! Fucking! Second!"
BOOM!
Luxanna chased the obsidian streak toward the boundary of Chernobyl, and the boundary refused to let her reach it.

She felt it the moment she committed to the pursuit. Invisible shackles formed around her torn body, not from any being, not from any visible attack, but from the Observable Existence itself. Chernobyl reached up and grabbed her!

The substrate she had been flying through became hands, the air became chains, the reborn domain that answered to the being who had rebuilt it decided she was not permitted to leave, and it pulled her down. THE Domain of the Genesis Monarch had marked her as a Fourth Scale existence to be contained, and even with her third-rarity Intent resisting, even with her existence straining against the hold, the domain dragged her back from the edge she had nearly reached.
The obsidian streaks vanished into THE Undefined Gaps. Noah was gone. Seo-yeon was gone. The Swords of Existence and the Relictus, gone!
And Luxanna was held in place by an existence that hated her.
She roared.

"You cowards! You absolute cowards, you ran, you actually ran, you held me down like a child and you ran!" She thrashed against the invisible shackles, her silver Acedia Intent raging uselessly against a domain that did not care about her records because it had its own.

"Osmont, or whatever your name is, you slippery little thing, you spineless gorgeous monster, you don’t get to do that to me and just leave! And you! Source Lifeform! Manners maketh man, you said, manners, you pompous obsidian-suited bag of etiquette, where were your manners when you grabbed my prize and dove into a hole! Cowards! All of you! Those ugly oversized lizards you call Relictus, those overgrown fucking pets, I will skin every one of them and make a coat, do you hear me! A big fuckin coat!"
BOOM!

The shackles held her. The domain did not answer her insults. It simply kept her in place, the wrath of a freshly reborn Observable Existence pressing down on the dragon who had tried to make it a battlefield.
Only when she stopped trying to go out did they fade away.
A second later, the sky cracked.

Dozens of titanic Ragnars descended into Chernobyl, each emanating the heavy aura of the Fourth Scale, and these were nothing like the soulless Dredge units Noah had erased in nine seconds. These carried their full will and their full power.

Some blazed with the crimson war-fury of Ira Intents. Some pressed down with the golden weight of Superbius Intents. Others spread the dulling silver of Acedia Intents, and every one of them was more terrifying than the single Ragnar Noah had first assessed, each carrying a second-rarity Intent wielded by a being that knew exactly how to wield it.
Behind them came something worse.
A group of women descended, each accompanied by their Custodes, and the air itself seemed to compose itself around them as they arrived. THE Magna Sorora!

They were unblemished in their power, beautiful in the way that beings of immense standing were beautiful, and their Intents pressed against the reborn domain with a weight that made the Ragnars seem ordinary. Every one of them carried a third-rarity Intent. Not one Titan Intent among the leadership the way Luxanna had been the rare exception in her own force. All of them!
A gathering of Titan-rarity Akashic Civilizational Intents, arrived together!

At their head was a woman with radiant gold hair, a crown hanging diagonally across her head, her presence carrying the composed authority of a being who commanded the rest without needing to assert it.
She looked at the contained Luxanna.
"What happened here?"she asked.
Luxanna stopped thrashing, her frustration channeling into the report through gritted teeth.

"A Lifeform that can resuscitate a Terminal Observable Existence," she said. "And a Lifeform that can Bless another to gain THE Primordial Source. A man and a little girl. This is them. The two of them. They are the answer. Both of them. The answer to everything our entire civilization has ever wanted, and they slipped into THE Undefined Gaps two seconds before I could close my hand on them."

She waved a hand, and the illusory images of Noah and Seo-yeon formed in the air between the gathered Magna Sorora. The man burning with silent Infinity that could not be seen through. The little girl in tattered blue rags, carrying both foundational natures in her small frame.

The golden-haired woman reached out and took the illusory images, and the other Sororis Prima around her did the same, each of them drawing the faces into their own perception, studying them with the focused attention of beings committing something to the deepest layers of their memory.
When she spoke, her voice carried a weight that made the entire gathered force go still.

"Memorize these faces," she said. "Dream of these faces. Hold them in your existence until they are carved there permanently. We will have a location for you soon enough, because beings like this do not stay hidden, no matter where they run. And when we have it, you will move. All of you." Her eyes moved across the assembled Ragnars and Sororis Prima and Custodes.

"They must be found. They must be recovered. At all cost. Whatever it requires, whatever it consumes, whatever Observable Existence must burn to flush them out. The man who can bring dead domains back to life, and the girl who can hand us THE Primordial Source. Found, and recovered. At all cost."
She let the silence hold.
"Understood?"

The answer came back from dozens of Fourth Scale throats at once, the Ragnars and the Sororis Prima and the Custodes speaking as one, the word carrying across the reborn sky of Chernobyl with the unified weight of a force that had just been given its single most important purpose.
"Understood!"
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5334: Sword of Existence! II
paragraphs: Noah crossed through THE Undefined Gaps with a little girl on his back.

Seo-yeon had climbed up at some point during the transit, settling onto his shoulder with the comfort of an an Infinite...Source Lifeform who had decided this was a perfectly acceptable way to travel, her small legs swinging back and forth as the unstable rivers of undefined potential streamed past them. Like all of this was nothing dangerous to her!

She showed no fear of the Gaps that would have reduced lesser beings to nothing. She had spent eons holding the endings of an entire Observable Existence. The spaces between defined reality held no particular terror for a being who had carried that.
Ahead of them, Sir William moved.

Noah watched the Source Lifeform reach into his existence and pull out a square wall of obsidian, and he recognized it immediately. It was similar to THE Advent Wall that the Gilded Ones used to enter THE Strand of Broken Scales, the gateway that had carried him and Eon across the boundary into THE Source Lands.

But where the Gilded Ones’ wall had felt improvised, a thing assembled and reverse-engineered from something else and used carefully by beings who did not entirely belong on the other side of it, Sir William’s was smaller and yet far more official.
Complete. The wall of a being who had every right to use it!
Sir William unleashed his Primordial Source into the wall.

Vibrant swirling obsidian light began to wrap around all of them, and Noah felt the pull take hold of his existence, a force drawing him toward someplace extremely far away, the same kind of pull he had felt crossing THE Advent Wall but cleaner, smoother, official in a way the prior crossing had not been. He was not sneaking in this time. He was being received!

As the obsidian rivers swirled around him, his attention remained partly with Chernobyl, his connection to the resuscitated Observable Existence still active, and through it he saw what had arrived in the domain he was leaving behind.

Dozens of Fourth Scale Ragnars with full will and full power. A gathering of Magna Sorora, every one of them carrying a third-rarity Intent. The golden-haired Sororis Prima taking his image and Seo-yeon’s image and committing them to memory, ordering them found and recovered at all cost.
He held the knowledge without alarm. They had his face now. That was a problem for the future, and the future was a place he had every intention of arriving at on his own terms!
For now, Chernobyl would hold, freshly rebuilt and backed by his Infinite Cause, and he was crossing into a place those forces could not follow.
Well, at least not the particular location be was now going to. He didnt know how vast it would be from where his body was in THE Strand of Broken Scales.
BOOM!
Existence twisted and distorted around them, and then the obsidian rivers faded, and Noah felt THE Source Lands open around this body of his.

It was different from before. When he had crossed with Eon into THE Strand of Broken Scales, the air had been dense and dangerous, the place vibrant but hostile, every breath carrying the awareness that survival was conditional. Here the air was freer and grander, carrying the same purity and immensity of THE Source Lands but without the sense of being somewhere he was not meant to be!
He breathed it in, and Seo-yeon breathed it in beside his ear as her mouth opened with a wide O, and both of them looked around with shining eyes.
They had arrived on vibrant green-gold grasslands.

Massive ancient trees lined the landscape to the left and right, their leaves a deep gold that caught the light of distant Illumination Flowers, their trunks rising toward a sky that felt higher and wider than any sky had a right to feel.
The grasslands climbed gently upward toward a massive mountain in the distance, and across the mountain’s face were structures, dozens of them, exquisite and equally massive, shining obsidian gold.

Some were castles, vast and radiant. Others were towers that rose so high their tops were difficult to find. The whole mountain was a settlement, but a settlement built on a scale that made the Gilded Ones’ bone-reinforced encampment in THE Strand of Broken Scales look like a child’s effort at architecture.
And on the grasslands where they had arrived, Noah did not have to look far before the Relictus noticed them.

Dozens of them raised their heads across the landscape. Obsidian-scaled Relictus in lizard-like draconic forms, their bodies vast and ancient, their scales the deep obsidian of beings constituted by THE Primordial Source.

They lifted their regal heads from where they had been lounging across the grasslands, and they gazed at Noah and Seo-yeon and Sir William with the unhurried attention of creatures assessing the new arrivals. They found that the new arrivals were accompanied by Sir William, nodded toward the group in something that was almost courtesy, and then lowered their heads again, returning to their lounging with the lazy contentment of apex beings at rest in their own territory.
Beyond the lounging Relictus, Noah could sense more.

Terrifying auras of the Third and Fourth Scale moved through the distant structures on the mountain, and the deeper into the place he directed his perception, the more terrifying the auras became, some of them pressing against his senses with a weight that suggested they exceeded anything he had yet personally faced!

This was not a place where powerful beings occasionally gathered. This was a place where powerful beings lived, in their thousands, in their millions, the population density of immense power unlike anywhere he had been!
Sir William turned to them, standing taller now that he was home, and began to introduce the place.

"This is THE Hallowed Demesne," he said."It is the place where Swords of Existence are received. Where we come to choose our missions, to rest between them, to cultivate, to gather, to be among our own. Within its bounds move millions of Source Lifeforms, and a great many beings beyond Source Lifeforms who serve the cause in their own capacities."

His measured cadence held the pride of a being describing something he genuinely revered."It exists within THE Source Lands, but apart from the wild and lawless territories like THE Strand of Broken Scales where the Gilded Ones make their incursions. Here there is order. Here there is rule. And the rule, and the wisdom beneath it, belongs to Her Majesty, THE Queen Regnant."
BOOM!

Vibrant swirling obsidian light began to wrap around all of them, and Noah felt the pull take hold of his existence, a force drawing him toward someplace extremely far away, the same kind of pull he had felt crossing THE Advent Wall but cleaner, smoother, official in a way the prior crossing had not been.
He was not sneaking in this time.
He was being received!

As the obsidian rivers swirled around him, his attention remained partly with Chernobyl, his connection to the resuscitated Observable Existence still active, and through it he saw what had arrived in the domain he was leaving behind.
Dozens of Fourth Scale Ragnars with full will and full power.
A gathering of Magna Sorora, every one of them carrying a third-rarity Intent.
The golden-haired Sororis Prima taking his image and Seo-yeon’s image and committing them to memory, ordering them found and recovered at all cost.
He held the knowledge without alarm.
They had his face now.
That was a problem for the future, and the future was a place he had every intention of arriving at on his own terms!
For now, Chernobyl would hold, freshly rebuilt and backed by his Infinite Cause, and he was crossing into a place those forces could not follow.
Well, at least not the particular location be was now going to.
He didnt know how vast it would be from where his body was in THE Strand of Broken Scales.
BOOM!
Existence twisted and distorted around them, and then the obsidian rivers faded, and Noah felt THE Source Lands open around this body of his.
It was different from before.
When he had crossed with Eon into THE Strand of Broken Scales, the air had been dense and dangerous, the place vibrant but hostile, every breath carrying the awareness that survival was conditional.
Here the air was freer and grander, carrying the same purity and immensity of THE Source Lands but without the sense of being somewhere he was not meant to be!
He breathed it in, and Seo-yeon breathed it in beside his ear as her mouth opened with a wide O, and both of them looked around with shining eyes.
They had arrived on vibrant green-gold grasslands.

Massive ancient trees lined the landscape to the left and right, their leaves a deep gold that caught the light of distant Illumination Flowers, their trunks rising toward a sky that felt higher and wider than any sky had a right to feel.
The grasslands climbed gently upward toward a massive mountain in the distance, and across the mountain’s face were structures, dozens of them, exquisite and equally massive, shining obsidian gold.
Some were castles, vast and radiant.
Others were towers that rose so high their tops were difficult to find.
The whole mountain was a settlement, but a settlement built on a scale that made the Gilded Ones’ bone-reinforced encampment in THE Strand of Broken Scales look like a child’s effort at architecture.
And on the grasslands where they had arrived, Noah did not have to look far before the Relictus noticed them.
Dozens of them raised their heads across the landscape.
Obsidian-scaled Relictus in lizard-like draconic forms, their bodies vast and ancient, their scales the deep obsidian of beings constituted by THE Primordial Source.

They lifted their regal heads from where they had been lounging across the grasslands, and they gazed at Noah and Seo-yeon and Sir William with the unhurried attention of creatures assessing the new arrivals.

They found that the new arrivals were accompanied by Sir William, nodded toward the group in something that was almost courtesy, and then lowered their heads again, returning to their lounging with the lazy contentment of apex beings at rest in their own territory.
Beyond the lounging Relictus, Noah could sense more.

Terrifying auras of the Third and Fourth Scale moved through the distant structures on the mountain, and the deeper into the place he directed his perception, the more terrifying the auras became, some of them pressing against his senses with a weight that suggested they exceeded anything he had yet personally faced!
This was not a place where powerful beings occasionally gathered.
This was a place where powerful beings lived, in their thousands, in their millions, the population density of immense power unlike anywhere he had been!
Sir William turned to them, standing taller now that he was home, and began to introduce the place.
"This is THE Hallowed Demesne," he said."It is the place where Swords of Existence are received.
Where we come to choose our missions, to rest between them, to cultivate, to gather, to be among our own.
Within its bounds move millions of Source Lifeforms, and a great many beings beyond Source Lifeforms who serve the cause in their own capacities."

His measured cadence held the pride of a being describing something he genuinely revered."It exists within THE Source Lands, but apart from the wild and lawless territories like THE Strand of Broken Scales where the Gilded Ones make their incursions.
Here there is order.
Here there is rule.
And the rule, and the wisdom beneath it, belongs to Her Majesty, THE Queen Regnant."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5335: Sword of Existence! III
paragraphs: Noah’s eyes shone as he took in the full breadth of THE Hallowed Demesne, the grasslands and the golden trees and the mountain of obsidian gold structures and the lounging Relictus and the distant terrifying auras.
On his shoulder, Seo-yeon’s eyes sparkled.
"Wow," she breathed. "Seo-yeon has never seen anything like this before!"

She looked around at everything, her small head turning to take it all in."I was locked up this whole time. The whole, whole time! I only ever saw the storm and the endings and the dark. I never saw grasslands. Or gold trees. Or big lazy lizards just lying around like that!"

She pointed at a lounging Relictus with the delighted lack of fear of an entity who was understanding that existence was suddenly full of wonderful things. "Look at them! They’re so big and fat and they don’t even care about anything!"

She said it casually, joyfully, the simple wonder of a being seeing the open world for the first time after an eternity of confinement, and Noah couldnt help but smile. She deserved to see grasslands. She deserved to point at lazy lizards!
He turned his attention back to Sir William’s words, and one phrase had caught on something in his mind.
"Her Majesty?" he asked. "THE Queen Regnant?"
Sir William stood taller still.

Around them, the other three Source Lifeforms who had fought at Chernobyl appeared, materializing from their own transit through THE Undefined Gaps, and the twelve Relictus that had answered Sir William’s call settled onto the grasslands behind them, taking their places among the lounging native Relictus with the ease of beings returning home. The full party that had escaped Chernobyl reassembled in THE Hallowed Demesne, and Sir William spoke into their gathering with the gravity of someone introducing the being he answered to above all others.

"Her Majesty, Victoria,"he said. "THE Queen Regnant of THE Hallowed Demesne and many other regions of THE Source Lands. She is the one who unified the Source Lifeforms of these regions of THE Source Lands under a single banner, in an age when they moved as scattered powers without common cause, each pursuing their own survival and their own ascension and answering to nothing but themselves."

"She gathered them. She gave them a standard to serve and an order to belong to, and she did it not through conquest but through the simple fact of what she was, a being so undeniable that the proud and the powerful chose to follow her rather than continue alone."
He let the weight of it settle.

"She is the First Sword of Existence. THE Origin Sword. The one from whom the designation itself descends, the being whose example defined what it means to be a blade of existence that serves THE Primordial Source and follows its own Way. Every Sword that has ever been sworn was sworn in the tradition she began."He looked at Noah directly.

"And you have more than shown your capability to be a Sword of Existence. What you did in Chernobyl exceeded what any trial would have asked of you. You demonstrated something that the Swords of Existence have never seen a candidate demonstrate. There is no further trial required. You can be sworn in her name, and take your Oath, today."
Oh?
Noah’s eyes shone brightly as he turned the introduction over in his mind.
THE Origin Sword. The First Sword of Existence. A being who had unified millions of Source Lifeforms under a single banner not through conquest but through the sheer undeniability of what she was!
A Queen Regnant who sat at the head of all of this, of THE Hallowed Demesne and its mountains of obsidian gold structures and its lounging Relictus and its distant terrifying auras.
What Scale was a being like that in?

He could sense the auras throughout THE Hallowed Demesne, Third Scale and Fourth Scale and things that pressed beyond what he could cleanly categorize, and if those were the beings who served her, who lived within her order and followed her rule, then the being they all answered to had to be something he did not yet have a frame for.
Something that made even the gathered power of THE Hallowed Demesne into subjects!
Without any further tests, without any more trials, on the strength of what he had shown in Chernobyl alone, he could be sworn as a Sword of Existence.
He smiled.

Seo-yeon swung her legs on his shoulder and looked around at the wonderful new world, and Noah looked toward the distant mountain of obsidian gold where a being he very much wanted to understand was waiting.
"Today, then," he said.
Noah moved across the green-gold grasslands of THE Hallowed Demesne, following Sir William toward the distant mountain of obsidian gold structures.

Seo-yeon did not stay on his shoulder. She floated off to drift near the lounging Relictus, her eyes wide with wonder, examining the vast obsidian-scaled creatures the way a child examined animals at a place built for looking at animals.

She circled one of them, peering at its scales, its claws, the slow rise and fall of its massive flank as it rested, and the Relictus tolerated this with the lazy patience of a being that had seen many curious things across its long existence and found a small girl among the least concerning.
One of them, however, was less patient.

A Relictus toward the edge of the group lifted its head and released a portion of its Fourth Scale pressure toward Seo-yeon, just a sliver of its Intent, the kind of thing a large creature did to shoo away something small that had gotten too close. It was not malice. It was annoyance, the equivalent of a swat, meant to startle the little girl into giving it space.
Seo-yeon startled.
Then she pouted.
And then she swung her small hand toward the Relictus.
HUUUM!

A sharp Akashic Civilizational Intent filled with budding Infinity and THE Primordial Source erupted from her tiny frame, vast and sudden and entirely disproportionate to her size, and it swept past the Relictus and threw the Fourth Scale creature miles across the grasslands, the obsidian-scaled body tumbling through the air before crashing down in the distance with a force that left a furrow in the green-gold earth!
Silence fell across the immediate area!

chapters.title: Chapter 5336: Sword of Existence! IV
paragraphs: Noah blinked, his eyes shining!

The Apocalypse Cause she had been pulling in during Chernobyl’s transformation, the Fourth Scale equivalent immensity she carried, the Infinite Anomalous Source Factor that let her copy and embody what she touched.
She had been steeping in the resuscitated domain’s power and her own nature was already terrifying. A pout and a swing of her hand had thrown a Fourth Scale Relictus miles!
She had done it the way a toddler knocked over a cup, without calculation, purely as a reflex of displeasure!

The other Relictus around her raised their heads in shock, staring at the small girl who had just casually hurled one of their own across the landscape, and Seo-yeon stared right back at the one she had thrown, her little face fierce, daring it to try startling her again.
Sir William looked between Noah and Seo-yeon, and something in his composed features suggested he had just recognized that the little girl was going to be a source of complications wherever she went.
He turned to the three other Source Lifeforms who had arrived with them.
"Go ahead and debrief," he said."I will handle the ceremony."

The three departed toward the mountain, and Sir William turned back to Noah, glancing once more at Seo-yeon, who was now staring down the Relictus that had raised its head in startled shock, her hands on her hips, every bit of her small frame communicating that she would do it again.
"Why... don’t we go directly to THE Saint Source Palace for your ceremony," Sir William said. "Rather than walk the full distance and risk further incidents along the way."
His glance toward Seo-yeon made the reasoning clear. "I will teleport us directly there. You will get the chance to explore afterwards"
Noah smiled and nodded.

He reached out and Seo-yeon floated back to him, settling against his side, still casting a final fierce look at the Relictus. Sir William grasped his sword, and a brief obsidian light covered the three of them, and they disappeared from the grasslands.
They appeared inside a grand castle located deeper within THE Hallowed Demesne.

The hall they arrived in was vast, its ceiling lost somewhere far above, and it was lined along both walls with regalia. Suits of knightly armor stood in rows, each one distinct, each one carrying the weight of having belonged to someone.

Swords hung mounted between them, and weapons of every description, hammers and spears and bows and flails and armaments Noah had no name for currently, each one an Armament of a Sword of Existence, displayed with the reverence of relics.
The whole hall felt saturated with history and complexity, the accumulated record of an order that had existed long enough to fill a space this size with the tools of beings who had served it.
Ahead, three massive statues sat on thrones, vast figures Noah did not yet recognize, their faces carrying the stern grandeur of beings memorialized for things the hall did not explain.
And before the statues stood a Source Lifeform.

She stood tall and graceful, holding a radiant obsidian sword with its tip pointed down toward the floor, both hands resting on its pommel. She was adorned in metallic armor that covered her entire body except her head, the armor obsidian and gold and worked with a craftsmanship that made the displayed regalia around the hall look ordinary by comparison.
Her bearing was the bearing of a being who had stood exactly this way for a very long time and would continue to stand this way for a very long time more.
Noah gazed at her, and looked into her obsidian eyes.
His existence buzzed with danger instantly.

It was not a threat she was making. She stood perfectly still, sword pointed down, simply present. But her power pressed against his perception with a suffocating weight that he felt in his foundations, a pressure that his existence recognized as belonging to something far beyond what he had yet faced, something that made the gathered Magna Sorora and the Fourth Scale Ragnars of Chernobyl feel like a lower category of concern.
|Source Lifeform- assessment.|
|Designation: Dame Seraphine, THE Knighting Sword.|
|Standing: Vakochev’s Fifth Scale of Existence. THE Mesozoic Scale.|

|Distinction: A Sword of Existence charged with the knighting of new Swords. She administers the Oath and confers the official standing upon those who have proven worthy. She has knighted Swords across an immense span of the order’s history. Her authority in this matter is absolute, and her judgment of a candidate is final.|

|Note: She is beyond the Fourth Scale. THE Triassic Scale is where beings become truly powerful. THE Mesozoic Scale is not yet defined.Direct conflict with this being is not advisable under any current circumstance.|
THE Mesozoic Scale. THE Fifth!

Noah held the assessment with the cold composure he held everything, but inwardly he marked it carefully. He had just begun to feel thatweakFourth Scale entities were manageable, that he could wound a Relictus like Calypso.

And here was a being a full Scale beyond that, standing in a hall as the one who administered Oaths, treated as functionary rather than pinnacle. If a Mesozoic Scale being was the one who handled knightings, then THE Queen Regnant, THE Origin Sword, the being all of this answered to, was something even further beyond.
Sir William bowed with deep respect toward Dame Seraphine.

Even Seo-yeon hid behind Noah, peering out from behind his leg with astonishment, her earlier fierceness entirely gone in the presence of a being whose pressure her instincts correctly read as something not to provoke.
Dame Seraphine raised her sword slightly, and spoke, her voice booming through the vast hall.
"A new Sword has passed the trials and arrived before me," she said. "Are you ready to take your Oath?"
Sir William stepped forward.

"Your Grace," he said, "this is the Trial Sword whose details I sent a short while ago. Alongside his capabilities, and an account of what occurred within Chernobyl." He inclined his head."I sponsored him. I stand by the sponsorship. What he demonstrated exceeds what any standard trial measures, and I believe he warrants your direct attention rather than the usual proceeding."
Dame Seraphine’s obsidian eyes shifted to Noah fully, and as the details Sir William referenced settled into her understanding, they lit with genuine interest.

She was quiet for a moment, studying the man before her. The silent Infinity that could not be seen through. THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian still radiating faintly from his frame others wouldn’t know of. The little girl hiding behind his leg who carried both THE Primordial Source and Infinity. The account of a Terminal Observable Existence rebuilt by his hands.
"Interesting," she said. "Very interesting."

She raised her radiant obsidian sword from where its tip had rested against the floor, the motion smooth and deliberate, the suffocating pressure of a Mesozoic Scale being shifting through the hall as she did.
"Okay," she said. "Then we shall give him the special treatment."

chapters.title: Chapter 5337: Sword of Existence! V
paragraphs: The special treatment.
This was what Noah was supposed to receive, and the grand visage of Dame Seraphine locked onto him as she spoke.
"Step forward."

Noah raised his brows but followed, his steps light. He patted Seo-yeon’s head and communicated for her to wait, and she settled, watching with inquisitive eyes as he moved toward the Mesozoic Scale being holding the radiant obsidian sword.

He was genuinely interested in her, more interested than the ceremony itself warranted, because beings of higher Scales were the ones he most enjoyed studying. Peeling away the secrets of something that operated above his current tier was the kind of thing that taught him where his own ceiling actually was, and he had never met a ceiling he did not eventually want to break.
He arrived before her. She looked at him calmly. He looked back at her just as coolly, two beings taking each other’s measure across the gap of a full Scale.
Her power was immense, pressing against him with the suffocating weight of the Mesozoic, and her voice carried that weight when she spoke.
"To be a Sword of Existence is easy, in the end," she said. "All it requires is an Oath. An oath not to harm Source Lifeforms, and to work in the interest of existence. Are you ready?"
"I’m ready," Noah said, nodding calmly.
Dame Seraphine raised her sword and brought its flat side to shine above him.
"The first step to accepting the Oath," she said, "is to kneel."
HUUM!
To kneel?
Noah frowned at the word. A moment later, terrifying pressure descended from Dame Seraphine, stifling and heavy, pressing down on him from every direction. Her gaze remained calm as she repeated it.
"Kneel."
The pressure crashed down all around him.

|Pressure analysis: Dame Seraphine is exerting a Mesozoic Scale will-suppression. This capability is designed solely to suppress the will and force submission. It does not harm the target in any other way, deals no physical damage, and exists purely to compel a being to kneel through the imposition of overwhelming superior will. Resistance is a contest of will against a being one full Scale above you.|
Noah bore the pressure!

He felt it press against his foundations, against his will, the sheer weight of a being who operated a full Scale beyond him bearing down with the simple expectation that he would fold beneath it the way most beings folded. His knees were meant to buckle. His will was meant to yield!
The pressure existed for no purpose except to make a being kneel, and beings of every tier had knelt beneath it across the long history of the order.
He remained standing.
Dame Seraphine smiled when she saw it.
"Will that be a problem?" she asked, her tone carrying genuine curiosity rather than displeasure. "Will you not kneel?"
Noah looked up at the sword shining above him, at the Mesozoic Scale being holding it, and his reply came grand and unhurried.

"I kneel before very few in existence," he said."I can kneel to hold my mother, or my child. I can kneel to hold my woman. You are neither of those things."His eyes held hers, inviolable. "So I cannot kneel before you."
BOOM!
His words were staunch, immovable, the declaration of a being who had decided long ago what his knees were for, and Dame Seraphine smiled brilliantly at them.

"Good," she said. "I had to know."She let the pressure ease. "Half of all who are sworn as Swords of Existence kneel beneath that pressure. Half resist it. There is no shame in either, and I tell every candidate this truthfully. Exceptional Swords have risen from both halves, beings of great accomplishment who knelt and beings of great accomplishment who did not."

Her gaze sharpened with something deeper. "But there is one distinction. Of all the Swords of Existence whose names have come to resonate upon Vakochev’s Scales of Existence, whose records etched themselves into the framework of reality itself, not one ever knelt beneath that pressure. They came only from the half that stood. To kneel or not to kneel is a choice made before existence itself, and existence remembers which choice you made."
HUUM!
Her sword began to shine with scintillating obsidian light, and her demeanor turned serious.
"Then we proceed to the Oath," she said.

She raised her voice, and the words that came filled the vast hall with a weight that pressed back against even the displayed regalia of every Sword who had come before, ancient and grand and glorious.

"Before THE Primordial Source, before the long unbroken line of Swords who came before, and before existence itself which keeps the only record that lasts, you stand to be sworn. You will be a blade that existence keeps. You will protect what must be protected and end what must be ended, and you will know the difference not by the comfort of the choice but by the truth of it. You will follow your own Way, for a Sword without a Way is only a weapon, and you will follow THE Source above all standards beneath it. You will not harm Source Lifeforms save in defense of existence itself. You will move when the powerful do nothing, and you will not count the cost of moving, for the cost of standing idle is always greater. You will carry this until your existence ends or until existence has no further need of you, whichever arrives first."Her obsidian eyes blazed. "Do you agree to uphold this Oath?"
Noah looked grandly up at the sword shining above him.
"I agree to uphold the Oath."
HUUM!
The moment the words left him, Dame Seraphine brought her sword down, and a brilliant obsidian light bathed Noah completely.
|Oath of the Sword of Existence: Taken.|

|You are now an official Sword of Existence, sworn before Dame Seraphine, THE Knighting Sword. The Oath binds your existence. Its terms will hold and cannot be set aside through ordinary means. The binding is deniable only by a being who exceeds power equivalent to Vakochev’s Fifth Scale of Existence, THE Mesozoic Scale. Below that threshold, the Oath holds absolutely.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5338: Source! I
paragraphs: The scintillating light died down, and Dame Seraphine smiled.

"And so, a Sword of Existence is born," she said. "Whether your name will be carved and recorded across existence, or whether you will serve and pass unremembered, is yet to be seen. That is for your records to decide, not for me."She studied him.

"But you are a bit special. So let us give you your special treatment. Because you are special, a directive will likely arrive with missions tailored specifically to you. Others among the Swords are sent to join Wars, or to specific Observable Existences to hunt Gilded Ones or Infinite Lifeforms. Yours may be geared more toward Terminal Observable Existences, given what you have shown yourself capable of."
She raised a finger.

"But before you can act as a Sword, you require Clearance. That comes from me, or from a few others of sufficient standing. I must deem you battle-ready, that you have sufficient strength to protect yourself, because a Sword that dies is a failure of the order, and you especially cannot die. So." Her smile turned faintly mischievous. "Let us see whether you have the qualities you need."
HUUM!
A brilliant light flashed through the hall, and all of them disappeared.
They appeared at the edges of THE Hallowed Demesne, inside what looked to be a farm.

Noah’s interest sharpened immediately, because he had his own farm in THE Infiniverse and the cultivation of potent things was a pursuit he genuinely enjoyed. Plots of land stretched across the area, each one filled with terrifyingly potent Source Herbs, the plants blazing with concentrations of energy that pressed against his perception with the density of things grown in THE Source Lands across long careful cultivation.
He walked toward a plot and touched the leaves of a Source Herb, and its details resolved before him.

|Source Herb — Primordial Essence Bloom. A cultivated plant that generates and stores Pure Primordial Essence within its structure. Slow to mature. Extraordinarily valuable. The Essence stored within a single mature specimen exceeds what most beings encounter in their entire existence.|

He turned the leaf between his fingers, filing the plant away as something worth acquiring for THE Infiniverse, as Seo-yeon drifted back to his side with inquisitive eyes, Dame Seraphine and Sir William behind them.

"I need to know you can fight,"Dame Seraphine said. "And I need to know you can run when running is the correct choice, because a Sword who cannot flee a losing situation is a dead Sword, and dead Swords serve no one. So your first task is simple."She gestured behind the plots of Source Herbs. "Catch that."
Noah turned to look behind the plots.
There, among the Source Herbs, were...chickens.

They were obsidian-feathered, each the size of a full-grown man, and there were nine of them scattered across the surrounding plots, pecking at the Source Herbs with the entitled leisure of creatures that considered the entire farm their personal feeding ground. Their feathers were a deep glossy obsidian that caught the light.

They held their heads high, their movements carrying an unmistakable arrogance, a prideful strut that suggested each one believed itself the most important thing in any space it occupied. They were grand, in their way. Ridiculous and grand at once.
Chickens.
He had to catch a chicken!
He turned to Dame Seraphine dubiously, but her expression remained entirely serious. Then she smiled, mischievous, clearly enjoying something he did not yet understand.
"Just some chicken,"she said. "Catch one quickly so we can proceed."
Noah looked back at the chickens, and the prompts resolved.
|Designation: Unknown Source Lifeform.|
|Available detail: The fastest lifeforms in existence.|
The fastest lifeforms in existence.
Noah approached the nearest chicken with caution and confidence of a being who had erased nine Fourth Scale Ragnars in nine seconds, but he knew there should be something unique here!
He reached for it, and...
WAA!
It was no longer there.

He had not seen it move. There had been a chicken, obsidian and arrogant, pecking at a Source Herb, and his hand had closed on the space it occupied, and the space was empty, and the chicken stood three meters to the left, regarding him with one flat disdainful eye as though he had done something mildly embarrassing.
Noah’s brow rose.

He reached again, faster. The chicken sidestepped without appearing to hurry, a single unbothered shuffle that put it exactly far enough from his hand to make contact impossible. He lunged. It drifted aside. He swept both arms in a motion that should have cornered it against a plot of Source Herbs, and it was simply elsewhere, pecking at a different herb, its back turned to him in a display of contempt so complete it bordered on artistry!
He could not touch a feather!

His amusement curdled into focus. He erupted with his power, THE Aura of THE Source Barbarian blazing across his frame, and began to seriously pursue them, moving now at speeds that blurred his passage across the farm.
|Unknown Source Lifeform — partial detail unlocked through proximity.|

|The entire existence of this lifeform gives off an extremely stable isotope of THE Primordial Source. While it is a version of THE Primordial Source rather than the source itself, it carries unique value. For a young Source Lifeform whose existence is already bathed in Pure Primordial Essence, absorbing this stable isotope can induce a reaction that may allow them to begin generating their own Pure Primordial Source.|
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes burned with wonder.
Generate his own Pure Primordial Source!

Not Essence, the precursor he had been flooded with, but the Source itself, the destination he had been chasing through every path available to him. He carried high concentrations of Pure Primordial Essence already, amplified a thousandfold by Seo-yeon’s Blessing, and if absorbing this isotope could induce the reaction, then catching one of these ridiculous chickens was not a test of his ability to be a Sword. It was a shortcut toward the single thing he wanted most.
He rushed the chickens at full speed.
"This looks fun!" Seo-yeon called, delighted. "Seo-yeon wants to try!"

She joined the chase, and Noah watched in something close to slow motion as her first attempt nearly worked. Her small hands came within a hair of an obsidian tail, closer than he had managed, and the chickens noticed. Three of them turned their heads toward her with arrogant flat stares, clucking in a cadence that sounded unmistakably like taunting, as if to ask why such a small thing thought it had any business trying.
Seo-yeon pouted and moved faster!
